title: A format can cut to a height without padding
body:
`.height(n)` pads short output to `n` rows and cuts long output to `n` rows ending in a dim `…`. coax's link popup wants only the cut: it sizes its box from the row count, so padding would grow every short popup to 15 rows. `markdown_popup_rows` in coax's `src/ui.rs` makes the cut itself.

## Proposal

`.max_height(n)`, which cuts as `height` does and never pads.
